name: Produktly
author: Produktly

sections.description:
Produktly allows you to build interactive product tours, checklists, feedback widgets, announcements, NPS, changelogs, micro surveys, smart tips and roadmaps for your web application.

This plugin integrates Produktly with your WordPress site.

Features:
* Easily add the Produktly script to your site.
* Enable/Disable on Frontend and/or Admin Dashboard.
* Automatically identify logged-in users with their WordPress User ID and metadata.

Learn more about Produktly and see live demos at produktly.com

External services

This plugin connects to Produktly (produktly.com) to load the necessary JavaScript for product tours and other widgets to function.

It sends the following data to Produktly (if enabled):
* Client Auth Token: To identify your account and load the correct tours.
* User ID and Metadata: If enabled, it sends the logged-in user’s ID, email, name, and role to allow for personalized tours and user tracking.

Service provided by Produktly:
* Terms of Service
* Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
If you don’t have a Produktly account yet, you should first create one at produktly.com

  1. On your WordPress admin dashboard, navigate to Plugins -> Add New.
  2. Search for “Produktly”.
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”.
  4. Use the Settings -> Produktly screen to configure the plugin.
  5. Enter your Client Auth Token (found in your Produktly Dashboard).

OR

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/produktly directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings -> Produktly screen to configure the plugin.
  4. Enter your Client Auth Token (found in your Produktly Dashboard).
sections.faq:
Do users needs to install anything?

No. Once the plugin is installed and activated, users will see the Produktly widgets automatically.

Does Produktly work on admin dashboard?

Yes. Produktly works on both frontend and admin dashboard. You can enable/disable it on either of them by going to Settings -> Produktly on your WordPress admin dashboard.

How do I get my Client Auth Token?

  1. Log in to your Produktly account at produktly.com
  2. Navigate to Settings -> Installation
  3. Copy the Client Auth Token

What is Produktly?

Produktly is an all-in-one platform for driving product-led growth. It allows you to build interactive product tours, checklists, feedback widgets, announcements, NPS, changelogs, micro surveys, smart tips and roadmaps for your web application.

Learn more about Produktly and see live demos at produktly.com
